name: When is interior paint repair typically part of a larger renovation project?

mainEntity.name: When is interior paint repair typically part of a larger renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior paint repair often becomes an integral part of a larger renovation when existing surfaces have significant damage beyond minor scuffs, such as large cracks, water stains, or drywall imperfections. For instance, in a whole-home remodel, new layouts or structural changes necessitate extensive drywall work, making comprehensive repainting essential for a cohesive finish. AKN Design Group integrates these painting and finishing steps into the overall project plan, ensuring that all surfaces are prepared and painted to a high standard, aligning with the new design. This managed process avoids piecemeal repairs and guarantees a consistent, high-quality aesthetic throughout your updated home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior paint repair is typically part of larger renovations when significant damage like cracks or water stains are present, or after structural changes in a whole-home remodel. AKN Design Group incorporates this into a managed process for a cohesive finish.
